_comment: Where one stage sits inside a whole report document, and how a live copy of it is put back. Read by frontend/e2e/stage-slice-unit.spec.ts (components/designworkshop/report/stageSlice.ts) and by android/app/src/test/.../DwStageSliceTest.kt (ui/designworkshop/DwStageSlice.kt), so the laptop and the handset cannot disagree about which pages belong to the stage being typed into. A block is written as a short string: 'H<level>:<text>' is a heading, anything else is a paragraph with that text. Expected ranges are [start, end) or null.

range.name: a stage runs to the next heading at its own level
